members.name: status
members.doc: Worst state the service reached that day.

members.name: uptime
members.doc: Share of the day the service answered, from 0 to 100. Defaults by status when omitted; days without data are left out of the average.

members.name: note
members.doc: Short note for the tooltip, such as the incident title.

types.name: StatusBarProps
types.doc: An uptime strip: one thin bar per day, colored by the worst state of that day, under an overall percentage. Bars rise in a wave once on view and the percentage counts up. Hovering, scrubbing or arrowing along the strip lifts the bars around the pointer and glides one tooltip between days; the legend dims every other state. Click a day to select it.

members.name: days
members.doc: One entry per day, oldest first.

members.name: label
members.doc: Name of the service. It also names the strip for assistive technology.

members.name: uptime
members.doc: Overall uptime in percent. Defaults to the average of the days that have data.

members.name: precision
members.doc: Decimal places of the overall percentage.

members.name: caption
members.doc: Text under the percentage. Defaults to "uptime, last {n} days".

members.name: selectedDate
members.doc: Selected day as YYYY-MM-DD, or null for none. Leave undefined to let the strip keep its own selection.

members.name: defaultSelectedDate
members.doc: Day selected at first when the strip keeps its own selection.

members.name: onSelectDate
members.doc: Called with the day that was clicked, or null when the selected day is clicked again.

members.name: locale
members.doc: Formatting locale. Fixed by default so server and client render the same labels.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
